title: observability: token-level KV cache hit metrics, consolidate dashboards, refine alert tuning
author: Evan Chen
description: Motivation: production incidents in the last quarter pointed to KV cache effectiveness variance across models and routes which drives token-level cost spikes and tail latency. This PR introduces token-level KV cache hit/miss metrics, a consolidated observability dashboard for token cost/latency breakdowns (per-model and per-route), and adjusts alert thresholds to reduce noisy alerts while surfacing true regressions. Includes instrumentation, dashboard panels, and alert rule updates. Related Linear: ENG-8934 (token-level observability), SRE-4121 (alert tuning).
commits: feat(obs): add token_kv_cache_hits metric and per-route labels
perf(obs): sample token-level cost delta and aggregate by model+route
chore(dashboards): consolidate token-cost and kv-metrics into single dashboard JSON
fix(alerts): reduce sensitivity on tail-latency alert and add suppression window
test(obs): add unit tests for metric labels and tracing spans
diff_summary: +742 additions across metrics instrumentation, dashboard JSON and alert rules
-128 deletions (mostly refactors of prior dashboard panels)

Zoe Li: Alert tuning LGTM but suggest a 5m suppression window for short-lived spikes from Canary traffic.
Evan Chen: Added 5m suppression to tail-latency rule and noted in release notes.

Laura Green: CI failing on lint for token_metrics.md — small markdown style nit fixed.
ci_history: initial run: lint failure (markdown style) - author fixed
release_notes: Added token-level KV cache hit/miss metrics with model, route, model_version and shard labels; consolidated token-cost and KV metrics dashboard; adjusted tail-latency and token-cost regression alerts with a 5m suppression window to reduce alert noise.
rollback_instructions: Revert to previous dashboard JSON and alert rules in observability/alerts/token_cost_and_latency_rules.yaml from commit before merge; metric instrumentation is additive and safe to leave but dashboards will not render missing panels.
testing_notes: Unit tests for metric label population and tracing span annotations added. Manual validation performed against staging with synthetic workload to verify KV hit-rate correlation with token cost. Frontend dashboard validated in Chrome and Firefox; panels lazy-load enabled for heavy queries.
observability_impacts: Improves visibility into per-token cost drivers and KV effectiveness. Expected to reduce false-positive tail-latency alerts and give SREs and runtime team direct signals for model-level regressions.
